subject.summary: Physicians, All Other (United States SOC 29-1229) is an aggregate physician category covering physicians not separately listed in the classification, excluding surgeons and specialties already listed separately; O*NET publishes no standalone task survey for this aggregate. Practice requires completing medical education, residency training, and obtaining the applicable state license, and the specific diagnostic, treatment, and signing scope follows state law, specialty training, and institutional authorization. This page uses the BLS broad physicians group to explain the common work loop and uses the 29-1229 standalone row to present wage and employment data. A United States qualification does not automatically equal a Chinese physician qualification.
